[中文](./README.md) # magpie-systalyze [Systalyze](https://systalyze.com) (`https://inference.systalyze.com/v1`) as a provider in [magpie](https://github.com/yetone/magpie): its 10 models ship with capabilities and prices, so one sign-in is enough to use them from magpie, Codex and OpenCode. Usage shows on the account row, in `magpie quota`, and in the gateway's `/v1/magpie/quotas`: paste a console session and you get the **official balance and real billing**; leave it out and the plugin estimates from magpie's own ledger. - **Models**: all 10 of `GET /v1/models` are preset in `models.mjs`, with context and output limits, vision, reasoning, the `low`/`medium`/`high` effort levels, and a reference price per million tokens. At runtime the real endpoint still wins: new models appear on their own, and when the endpoint is down the preset table comes back. - **API shape**: everything goes through `/v1/chat/completions` (`@ai-sdk/openai-compatible`). The vendor also serves `/v1/responses` and `/v1/messages`, but chat completions is the one shape that works for all 10 models, so there is no per-model API split. - **Usage (official)**: paste a `console.systalyze.com` session cookie when signing in (optional) and the card carries two rows — **Balance** (left / granted, with a real percentage) and **Today's spend** (USD, tokens, calls). - **Usage (estimate)**: without a console session it falls back to magpie's `usage.jsonl` and reports today's tokens and estimated cost only. Set a daily budget in the options and that window becomes a real percentage window, which magpie's router steers around. The card is deliberately just those two rows: 7 days / 30 days / per model are statistics magpie works out from its own ledger, so the plugin doesn't repeat them and doesn't fill the card up. ## Where usage comes from **The inference endpoint has no quota API.** It exposes four endpoints: `/v1/models`, `/v1/chat/completions`, `/v1/responses`, `/v1/messages`. All of the following answer 404 `{"error":{"message":"unknown route"}}`: `/v1/usage`, `/v1/me`, `/v1/balance`, `/v1/credits`, `/v1/quota`, `/v1/subscription`, `/v1/account`, `/v1/key`, `/v1/user`, `/v1/keys/me`, `/v1/limits/me`, `/v1/rate-limits`, `/v1/whoami`, `/v1/profile`, `/v1/plan`, `/v1/stats`, `/v1/billing`, `/v1/spend`, `/v1/dashboard/billing/*`, `/openapi.json`, `/docs`, `/swagger.json`. No response header carries a quota or a balance either (only Cloudflare's), so magpie's built-in `balance=/v1/usage` does not apply to a custom provider. **The balance lives on the console API.** `console.systalyze.com` is **a separate login system** (better-auth): an inference key against its `/api/v1/me` gets `401 {"error":{"code":"API401"}}`, but it accepts its own session cookie `__Secure-better-auth.session_token` (the one in F12 › Application › Cookies; that single cookie is enough). The plugin reads: | Request | What you get | |---|---| | `GET /api/v1/me` | email, `activeTenantId`, `activeProjectId` | | `GET /api/v1/tenants//billing` | `balance.availableMicroUsd` (remaining, micro-USD) | | `GET /api/v1/tenants//billing/grants` | top-ups and grants; their sum is the granted credit | | `GET /api/v1/projects//inference-usage?groupBy=day\|model` | real calls, tokens, `chargeMicroUsd` | So there are two paths and the plugin picks one: 1. **Session present → official numbers** (recommended). Two windows: the balance ("how much is left / out of how much", with a real percentage) and today's spend (USD, tokens, calls). Correct across clients and machines. 2. **No session → estimate from the local ledger.** It reads `~/.config/magpie/usage.jsonl`, keeps rows whose `provider` is `systalyze` / `systalyze-plugin` or whose `host` is `inference.systalyze.com`, sums today's tokens and prices them; `kind:"model_list"` probe rows are skipped. No extra permission, no network call — but **other clients (curl, other tools) are not counted here**, and the prices are estimates. An expired session (401) never breaks the output: the plugin falls back to the estimate and puts the reason in `magpie quota`'s `error`. ## Install In the magpie app: **Plugins › Discover › Unofficial plugins · GitHub**, search `systalyze`. Or from the command line (this repo carries the `magpie-plugin` topic): ```sh magpie plugin add github:zszwnes/magpie-systalyze ``` Or from a checkout: ```sh magpie plugin add ./ ``` ## Sign in ```sh magpie plugin login systalyze ``` It asks for two things, then for the `stlzi_` key: 1. **Account name** (optional) — left empty, the account shows as `key …last4`. 2. **Console session cookie** (optional) — paste it to get the official balance. Three forms are accepted: - a full cookie header: `__Secure-better-auth.session_token=…; other=…` - just the value (about 79 chars, starting with `s.`) - just `__Secure-better-auth.session_token=…` Where to get it: sign in to [console.systalyze.com](https://console.systalyze.com) → F12 → Application → Cookies → `https://console.systalyze.com` → `__Secure-better-auth.session_token` → copy the Value. It is **a login credential**, on par with a password: it is stored only in this machine's `~/.config/magpie/plugin-auth.json` under `metadata.console`, and the plugin sends it only to `console.systalyze.com`. Sessions last about 7 days; sign in again when it expires. Leaving it empty is fine — you can add the `consoleSession` option later, or just run `magpie plugin login systalyze` again. ```sh magpie provider test systalyze # one tiny real chat request magpie quota systalyze # the usage windows magpie models | grep systalyze # the models ``` ## Models All 10 models of `GET /v1/models` are preset in `models.mjs`; the fields come from probing the real endpoint: | Model | context | output | vision | price $/M (in / out / cache read) | |---|---|---|---|---| | `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017` | 1,048,576 | 384,000 | ✓ | 0.30 / 1.20 / 0.006 | | `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731` | 1,048,576 | 384,000 | — | 0.14 / 0.28 / 0.03 | | `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813` | 1,048,576 | 384,000 | — | 1.32 / 3.96 / 0.13 | | `zai-org/GLM-5.3` | 1,048,576 | 262,144 | — | 1.40 / 4.40 / 0.26 | | `zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash` | 1,048,576 | 262,144 | ✓ | 0.15 / 0.50 / 0.03 | | `zai-org/GLM-5.2` | 1,048,576 | 262,144 | — | 1.40 / 4.40 / 0.26 | | `moonshotai/Kimi-K3` | 1,048,576 | 131,072 | ✓ | 3.00 / 15.00 / 0.30 | | `Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B` | 262,144 | 131,072 | ✓ | 0.40 / 3.00 / 0.04 | | `google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it` | 131,072 | 32,768 | ✓ | 0.13 / 0.40 / 0.05 | | `meta-models/Muse-Glimmer-30B` | 131,072 | 32,768 | ✓ | 0.20 / 0.60 / 0.03 | - All of them take tool calls and reason; the effort levels are `low` / `medium` / `high` (probing showed `reasoning_effort` also accepts `minimal`/`xhigh`/`max`, but the plugin keeps the common subset). - The prices are **an estimate from public upstream list prices** — the vendor publishes none. Edit `cost` in `models.mjs` to change them. - At runtime the real `GET /v1/models` list wins; a model it doesn't know gets `genericModel()`'s conservative defaults, and when the endpoint is down the preset table comes back with a `magpie.fellBack` mark so magpie doesn't cache it for long. ## Usage windows **Two rows, whichever path is taken.** **With a console session (official):** | Window | Contents | Shape | |---|---|---| | Balance | `$50.9706 available · used $0.0294 / $51.0000` | percentage (`unit: usd`, `limit` = granted credit) | | Today (official) | `$0.0294 · 21K tokens · 282 calls` | `aside`, USD | **Without a session (local estimate):** | Window | Contents | |---|---| | Today (local estimate) | today's tokens, calls and estimated cost | Both are `aside` windows — **they show usage, they never stop you from using the key**. In the estimate path, giving a daily budget turns the today window into a real percentage window (`unit: usd`) and magpie's router starts steering around an account that is over it. ```sh magpie plugin options magpie-systalyze '{"budgetDaily":1}' ``` Budgets only affect the estimate path; on the official path the limit is the real granted credit. > **Why today's spend has no `N%`**: magpie only draws a percentage when a window carries `amount` or `limit`; > otherwise it prints `display` verbatim. Today's spend has no cap, so the plugin leaves `amount` and `limit` out — > adding them gets you a `0%` prefix that can never move. The balance window does have a real cap (the granted > credit), so it keeps `amount`/`limit`/`used`, and that percentage is real. ## Options | Option | Default | Meaning | |---|---|---| | `consoleSession` | `""` | Console session cookie. Given, the plugin reads the official balance and real billing; empty, it estimates from the local ledger. The one typed at sign-in is stored in the account's `metadata.console` and this option wins over it (handy for sharing one session across accounts, or topping it up without signing in again) | | `localUsage` | `true` | Off: show no estimate windows. It does **not** affect the official path | | `budgetDaily` | `0` | Daily budget in USD, estimate path only. `>0` turns the today window into a percentage one | ## Layout | File | What it does | |---|---| | `package.json` | Plugin metadata; `magpie.icon` is the site's own `console.systalyze.com/favicon.svg` (161×161, adapts to dark mode), used on the discovery card and the installed row | | `index.mjs` | The plugin: `config` / `auth`(methods, loader, usage) / `provider.models` / `chat.headers`; helpers hang off `_internal` (every function an entry file exports is called as a plugin) | | `models.mjs` | The preset capabilities and prices of the 10 models | | `console-usage.mjs` | Official numbers: normalises the session cookie, reads `/me`, `/billing`, `/billing/grants`, `/inference-usage?groupBy=day` (no per-model request), cached for 60 seconds | | `usage-store.mjs` | Reads `usage.jsonl`, sums per window, prices it (parsed rows cached by size+mtime) | | `test/smoke.mjs` | Offline smoke test; `REAL_KEY=stlzi_… node test/smoke.mjs` adds a check against the real endpoint | | `test/seed-usage.mjs` | Puts a few synthetic rows in a sandbox's `usage.jsonl`, so the windows have numbers | | `e2e.sh` | Manual check: this checkout in a real magpie, in a sandbox | ## Development ```sh npm test # offline smoke test, no network, no key REAL_KEY=stlzi_… npm test # adds a check against the real endpoint (10 models) ``` Manual check with a real magpie (sandbox in `.e2e/`, your own config untouched): ```sh SYSTALYZE_KEY=stlzi_… ./e2e.sh # add the plugin, sign in, list models, one real request SEED=1 SYSTALYZE_KEY=stlzi_… ./e2e.sh # also puts a few synthetic rows in the sandbox ledger SYSTALYZE_KEY=stlzi_… SYSTALYZE_CONSEC="$(cat cookie.txt)" ./e2e.sh # sign in with a console session too ``` A sandbox ledger starts empty, so without `SEED=1` all three windows read `0 tokens · 0 calls`. Release steps: [RELEASE.md](./RELEASE.md). ## Known behaviour - When a provider the user configured by hand already has the id, magpie renames the plugin's provider to `systalyze-plugin`; the usage sum counts both ids and the host name. - Occasional `503 {"error":{"message":"the model \`X\` is unavailable"}}` (seen once each on GLM-5.3 and Kimi-K3) — retry. An invalid `reasoning_effort` also shows up as a 503 rather than a 400. - The reasoning field isn't uniform: `deepseek-*` uses `message.reasoning_content`, the rest use `message.reasoning`; the gateway converts, and the plugin declares `interleaved.field` per model. - Failed requests (`status >= 400`) count as calls and are reported in the windows' `error`, but cost nothing. - The official path caches console responses for 60 seconds (at most one `/me`, `/billing`, `/billing/grants` and `/inference-usage` call per minute). A session lasts about 7 days; once it expires the reason shows up in `magpie quota`'s `error` and the plugin falls back to the estimate instead of failing. ## License MIT

[English](./README.en.md) # magpie-systalyze 把 [Systalyze](https://systalyze.com)（`https://inference.systalyze.com/v1`）接成 [magpie](https://github.com/yetone/magpie) 的 provider： 它服务的 10 个模型全部预置好能力表和价格，登录一次就能在 magpie、Codex、OpenCode 里用； 用量显示在账号行、`magpie quota` 和网关的 `/v1/magpie/quotas` 上——粘一个控制台会话就看**官方余额与真实计费**，不粘就按本机账本估算。 - **模型**：`GET /v1/models` 列出的 10 个模型全部预置（`models.mjs`），带上下文/输出上限、是否视觉、是否思考、思考档位 `low`/`medium`/`high` 和每百万 token 的参考价。运行时仍以真实接口为准：新上线的模型自动出现，接口挂了退回预置表。 - **接口形状**：全部走 `/v1/chat/completions`（`@ai-sdk/openai-compatible`）。供应商另有两种形状 `/v1/responses`、`/v1/messages` 也可用，但 chat 对 10 个模型都稳，不需要按模型分 API。 - **用量（官方）**：登录时把 `console.systalyze.com` 的会话 cookie 粘上（可选），卡片上就给出两行——**余额**（可用 / 授信，带真实百分比）和**今日消耗**（美元、token、次数），单位都是美元。 - **用量（估算）**：没有控制台会话时退回本机 `usage.jsonl`，只报今天的 token 与估算花费；选项里设预算可把它变成真正的额度窗口，用超了路由会绕开。 卡片刻意只有这两行：7 天 / 30 天 / 分模型这些统计 magpie 自己会从账本里算，插件不重复报，免得把卡片塞满。 ## 用量从哪来 **推理端点没有额度接口。** 它只暴露四个接口：`/v1/models`、`/v1/chat/completions`、`/v1/responses`、`/v1/messages`。 下面这些全部 404 `{"error":{"message":"unknown route"}}`： `/v1/usage`、`/v1/me`、`/v1/balance`、`/v1/credits`、`/v1/quota`、`/v1/subscription`、 `/v1/account`、`/v1/key`、`/v1/user`、`/v1/keys/me`、`/v1/limits/me`、`/v1/rate-limits`、 `/v1/whoami`、`/v1/profile`、`/v1/plan`、`/v1/stats`、`/v1/billing`、`/v1/spend`、 `/v1/dashboard/billing/*`、`/openapi.json`、`/docs`、`/swagger.json`。 响应头里也没有配额/余额字段（只有 Cloudflare 的头）。所以 magpie 给自定义 provider 配 `balance=/v1/usage` 这条路在这里不成立。 **余额在控制台那套 API 上。** `console.systalyze.com` 是另一套登录体系（better-auth），拿 inference key 打它的 `/api/v1/me` 是 `401 {"error":{"code":"API401"}}`；但它认自己的会话 cookie `__Secure-better-auth.session_token`（浏览器里 F12 › Application › Cookies 那一串，单独一个就够）。 插件用它读： | 请求 | 拿到什么 | |---|---| | `GET /api/v1/me` | 邮箱、`activeTenantId`、`activeProjectId` | | `GET /api/v1/tenants//billing` | `balance.availableMicroUsd`（剩余，微美元） | | `GET /api/v1/tenants//billing/grants` | 充值/赠送流水，求和即授信总额 | | `GET /api/v1/projects//inference-usage?groupBy=day\|model` | 真实调用数、token、`chargeMicroUsd` | 于是有两条路，插件自动选： 1. **有会话 → 官方数据**（推荐）。两个窗口：余额（还剩多少 / 授信多少，百分比是真的）和今日消耗 （当天美元花费、token、次数）。跨客户端、跨机器都对。 2. **没有会话 → 本机账本估算**。读 `~/.config/magpie/usage.jsonl`，筛出 `provider` 为 `systalyze` / `systalyze-plugin`、或 `host` 为 `inference.systalyze.com` 的行，汇总今天的 token 并乘价目表； 探测产生的 `kind:"model_list"` 行会被排除。不需要额外权限、不联网，代价是别的客户端（curl、别的工具） 的用量不在这里，价格是估算。 会话失效（401）时不会报错中断：插件退回估算，并把原因写在 `magpie quota` 的 `error` 里。 ## 安装 在 magpie 应用里：**插件 › 发现 › 非官方插件 · GitHub**，搜 `systalyze`。 或者用命令行（本仓库打了 `magpie-plugin` topic）： ```sh magpie plugin add github:zszwnes/magpie-systalyze ``` 也可以在本仓库目录里： ```sh magpie plugin add ./ ``` ## 登录 ```sh magpie plugin login systalyze ``` 问两项，然后粘贴 `stlzi_` 开头的 key： 1. **账号备注名**（可留空）——留空时账号显示为 `key …末四位`。 2. **控制台 session cookie**（可留空）——想要官方余额就粘上。三种写法都认： - 完整 cookie 头：`__Secure-better-auth.session_token=…; 其他=…` - 只贴那一串值（约 79 字符，以 `s.` 开头） - 只贴 `__Secure-better-auth.session_token=…` 从哪拿：登录 [console.systalyze.com](https://console.systalyze.com) → F12 → Application（应用）→ Cookies → `https://console.systalyze.com` → `__Secure-better-auth.session_token` → 复制 Value。 它是**登录凭据**，和密码同级：只存在本机 `~/.config/magpie/plugin-auth.json` 的 `metadata.console` 里，插件只发给 `console.systalyze.com`。会话约 7 天过期，过期后重登一次即可。 留空了也没关系，随时可以在选项里补 `consoleSession`，或者重跑 `magpie plugin login systalyze`。 ```sh magpie provider test systalyze # 冒烟：一次真实的 chat 请求 magpie quota systalyze # 看用量窗口 magpie models | grep systalyze # 看模型 ``` ## 模型 `GET /v1/models` 的 10 个模型全部预置（`models.mjs`），字段来自真实接口探测： | 模型 | context | 输出上限 | 视觉 | 价格 $/M（入 / 出 / 缓存读） | |---|---|---|---|---| | `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017` | 1,048,576 | 384,000 | ✓ | 0.30 / 1.20 / 0.006 | | `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731` | 1,048,576 | 384,000 | — | 0.14 / 0.28 / 0.03 | | `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813` | 1,048,576 | 384,000 | — | 1.32 / 3.96 / 0.13 | | `zai-org/GLM-5.3` | 1,048,576 | 262,144 | — | 1.40 / 4.40 / 0.26 | | `zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash` | 1,048,576 | 262,144 | ✓ | 0.15 / 0.50 / 0.03 | | `zai-org/GLM-5.2` | 1,048,576 | 262,144 | — | 1.40 / 4.40 / 0.26 | | `moonshotai/Kimi-K3` | 1,048,576 | 131,072 | ✓ | 3.00 / 15.00 / 0.30 | | `Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B` | 262,144 | 131,072 | ✓ | 0.40 / 3.00 / 0.04 | | `google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it` | 131,072 | 32,768 | ✓ | 0.13 / 0.40 / 0.05 | | `meta-models/Muse-Glimmer-30B` | 131,072 | 32,768 | ✓ | 0.20 / 0.60 / 0.03 | - 全部支持工具调用和推理；推理档位是 `low` / `medium` / `high`（实测 `reasoning_effort` 也接受 `minimal`/`xhigh`/`max`，但为保守取公共子集）。 - 价格是**上游公开报价的估算**——供应商不公布价格。改 `models.mjs` 的 `cost` 即改费率。 - 运行时以 `GET /v1/models` 的真实列表为准；新模型按 `genericModel()` 给保守默认值，接口挂了就退回预置表 并打上 `magpie.fellBack` 标记，让 magpie 不要缓存太久。 ## 开发与测试 ```sh npm test # 离线冒烟，不需要网络和 key REAL_KEY=stlzi_… npm test # 追加真接口校验（10 个模型） ``` 用真实 magpie 手动验证（沙箱在 `.e2e/`，不碰你自己的 magpie 配置）： ```sh SYSTALYZE_KEY=stlzi_… ./e2e.sh # 装插件、登录、看模型、跑一次真实请求 SEED=1 SYSTALYZE_KEY=stlzi_… ./e2e.sh # 另往沙箱账本里塞几条合成用量，看窗口动起来 SYSTALYZE_KEY=stlzi_… SYSTALYZE_CONSEC="$(cat cookie.txt)" ./e2e.sh # 连控制台会话一起登录，看官方余额 ``` 沙箱里的账本是空的，所以不塞 `SEED=1` 时三个窗口都是 `0 tokens · 0 次`。给了 `SYSTALYZE_CONSEC` 就走官方分支，窗口内容是余额和官方美元花费。 发版流程见 [RELEASE.md](./RELEASE.md)。 ## 已知行为 - 供应商 id 与用户手配的 provider 同名时，magpie 会把插件供应商改名成 `systalyze-plugin`； 用量统计已把两个 id 和 host 名都算进来。 - 偶发 `503 {"error":{"message":"the model \`X\` is unavailable"}}`（GLM-5.3、Kimi-K3 各见过一次）， 重试即可；非法 `reasoning_effort` 值也表现为 503 而不是 400。 - 推理内容字段不统一：`deepseek-*` 用 `message.reasoning_content`，其余用 `message.reasoning`； 网关会转换，插件按模型分别声明 `interleaved.field`。 - 失败请求（`status >= 400`）也计入次数并在窗口的 `error` 里提示，但不产生费用。 - 官方分支对控制台响应做 60 秒缓存（每 60 秒最多打一次 `/me`、`/billing`、`/billing/grants`、 `/inference-usage`）。会话约 7 天过期，过期后 `magpie quota` 的 `error` 里会写明原因， 插件退回本地估算而不是报错。 ## # 发版清单 / Release checklist

## 每次发版 / Every release

1. `npm test` must pass locally (CI runs the same, on Node 20 and 24).
2. **手动跑一遍真实 magpie / Run `./e2e.sh` against a real magpie and a real key** before tagging:
   ```sh
   SEED=1 SYSTALYZE_KEY=stlzi_... ./e2e.sh
   SYSTALYZE_KEY=stlzi_... SYSTALYZE_CONSEC="$(cat cookie.txt)" ./e2e.sh
   ```
   (`SEED=1` fills the sandbox ledger with a few synthetic rows, so the estimate windows have numbers to show.
   `SYSTALYZE_CONSEC` signs in with a console session, so the official windows have numbers.)
   Run both. Check that:
   - `plugin add` reports `systalyze (Systalyze, 10 models)`;
   - `plugin login systalyze` asks for the account name, the console session (optional) and the key, then
     doesn't ask again;
   - **estimate path** — `quota systalyze --json` shows exactly one window, `今日（本地估算）`, with
     `unit: "tokens"` and an `aside` flag;
   - **no stray `0%`** — the plain `quota systalyze` line must show the today window as bare text
     (`16K tokens · 1 次 · 约 $0.0060`), never prefixed with `0% (`; only the balance window and the
     `budgetDaily` window carry a percentage. In `--json` that means `amount`/`limit` are absent from
     the today window;
   - **official path** — with a session `quota systalyze --json` shows exactly two windows: the balance
     (`unit: "usd"`, `limit` = granted credit, `used` = share spent) and `今日（官方）`, an `aside` USD
     window printed as bare `$0.0294 · 21K tokens · 282 次` (no `0%` prefix, which is why it carries no
     `amount`); the account row shows the console email;
   - **two rows only** — no `近 7 天` / `近 30 天` / per-model window on either path, no `plan` field
     anywhere, and no `model` key in any window;
   - with `{"budgetDaily":1}` in the options the estimate today window switches to `unit: "usd"`,
     `limit` 1 and `used` = the estimate over that limit; it doesn't touch the official path;
   - a bogus session (`"consoleSession": "__Secure-better-auth.session_token=bogus"`) falls back to the
     estimate and `error` mentions 官方接口读不到;
   - `models` lists all 10 models under `systalyze/`, with context and output limits;
   - `provider test systalyze` gets an answer (a real chat request).
3. Bump `version` in `package.json` and commit.
4. Tag it and push the tag: `git tag v0.1.0 && git push origin v0.1.0`. The tag must be `v` + the package's version.
5. `publish.yml` runs the tests and then `npm publish --provenance --access public` over OIDC. Check the package page on npm for the provenance badge.

## 第一次发布（启用 trusted publishing）/ First publish

npm configures trusted publishing per package, in the package's settings, so the package has to exist first.

1. Create the GitHub repo `zszwnes/magpie-systalyze` and push `main`. `package.json`'s `repository.url` must match this repo exactly (`git+https://github.com/zszwnes/magpie-systalyze.git`).
2. Publish 0.1.0 by hand from a clean checkout of the tag:
   ```sh
   npm login
   npm publish --access public
   ```
   Don't push the `v0.1.0` tag before this: `publish.yml` would fail, because the package doesn't exist yet. If you push it afterwards, that run's publish step fails because 0.1.0 is already on npm, and that failure is expected.
3. On npmjs.com, go to **magpie-systalyze › Settings › Trusted publishing** and add **GitHub Actions** with:
   - organization or user: `zszwnes`
   - repository: `magpie-systalyze`
   - workflow filename: `publish.yml`
   - environment: leave it empty (the workflow uses none)
4. Use the new config within 2 days, or it lapses: bump to the next version and release with a tag as above, so the first OIDC publish happens.
5. Once it works, in the same Settings page set **Publishing access** to require 2FA and disallow tokens. Then only the workflow can publish. Revoke any automation token you made.

Requirements the workflow already meets:
- `permissions: id-token: write`
- Node ≥ 22.14 (the workflow uses 24)
- npm ≥ 11.5.1 (installed in the job)
- a GitHub-hosted runner

With trusted publishing npm adds provenance on its own; `--provenance` is kept so the intent is explicit.

# Issue tracker: GitHub

Issues and specs for this repo live as GitHub issues. Use the `gh` CLI for all operations.

## Conventions

- **Create an issue**: `gh issue create --title "..." --body "..."`. Use a heredoc for multi-line bodies.
- **Read an issue**: `gh issue view <number> --comments`, filtering comments by `jq` and also fetching labels.
- **List issues**: `gh issue list --state open --json number,title,body,labels,comments --jq '[.[] | {number, title, body, labels: [.labels[].name], comments: [.comments[].body]}]'` with appropriate `--label` and `--state` filters.
- **Comment on an issue**: `gh issue comment <number> --body "..."`
- **Apply / remove labels**: `gh issue edit <number> --add-label "..."` / `--remove-label "..."`
- **Close**: `gh issue close <number> --comment "..."`

Infer the repo from `git remote -v`; `gh` does this automatically when run inside a clone.

## Pull requests as a triage surface

**PRs as a request surface: no.** _(Set to `yes` if this repo treats external PRs as feature requests; `/triage` reads this flag.)_

When set to `yes`, PRs run through the same labels and states as issues, using the `gh pr` equivalents:

- **Read a PR**: `gh pr view <number> --comments` and `gh pr diff <number>` for the diff.
- **List external PRs for triage**: `gh pr list --state open --json number,title,body,labels,author,authorAssociation,comments` then keep only `authorAssociation` of `CONTRIBUTOR`, `FIRST_TIME_CONTRIBUTOR`, or `NONE` (drop `OWNER`/`MEMBER`/`COLLABORATOR`).
- **Comment / label / close**: `gh pr comment`, `gh pr edit --add-label`/`--remove-label`, `gh pr close`.
